strategies.name: first_5m_range_fvg_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:35 candle. On the 1-minute chart, wait for price to break one of those levels with a fair value gap, then wait for price to retest the FVG and for the retest candle to be engulfed before entering in the direction of the break.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop one tick beyond the lowest area traded into the fair value gap (or equivalent invalidation beyond the FVG retest extreme). Target a fixed 3:1 reward-to-risk and do not micromanage the trade.

strategies.name: first_15m_range_fvg_limit_reentry_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle. On the 5-minute chart, wait for price to break one of those levels with a fair value gap, then place a limit order on the FVG so that a trade is entered automatically when price retraces back into it.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop at/just beyond the first candle of the three-candle fair value gap pattern. Target a fixed 2:1 reward-to-risk and let the trade play out without micromanaging, even if price revisits the FVG before moving away.

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches two distinct strategies because the entry mechanics and exit parameters differ: a 5m/1m retest-plus-engulfing scalp with 3:1 target, and a 15m/5m passive-limit FVG day trade with 2:1 target.
